title: galeopsis ladanum var. filholiana
intro: Galeopsis ladanum var. filholiana, commonly known as the Himalayan galeopsis, is a plant species within the mint family Lamiaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering a range of health benefits, including its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory and a digestive aid. The therapeutic actions of Himalayan galeopsis include its use as an antispasmodic, relieving muscle cramps and spasms, and its application in treating respiratory issues such as coughs and colds. The bioactive constituents present in Himalayan galeopsis include iridoids, phenolic acids, and flavonoids, which contribute to its therapeutic properties and potential health benefits.
